title: The Soviet Counterstroke
subtitle: The Soviet offensive against the Yelnya salient
author: R.G. Cruise
phase: III — The Battle for Strategic Objectives
summary: An ongoing Soviet offensive against the Yelnya salient, with German positions, Soviet objectives and the limits of early reports kept distinct.
outlineTopics: The development of the Yelnya salient.
Its operational significance for Army Group Center.
Soviet attempts to eliminate the position during August.
The Soviet Reserve Front and Georgy Zhukov's command responsibilities.
Soviet 24th Army and the principal participating formations.
Artillery concentration and the Soviet offensive plan.
Soviet attacks against the salient's flanks.
Soviet losses and the operational limitations of the offensive.
The eventual connection between the Yelnya fighting and the emergence of Soviet Guards formations.
researchStatus: Editorial outline and date association established. Full researched narrative, claim-level citations and the dated military situation remain to be written and reconstructed.
referenceMapStatus: Candidate German General Staff plate from the supplied chronological sequence. The plate title/date, operational content and reuse conditions have not been independently verified for digitisation.
chronologyNotes: The salient had not been fully eliminated on 3 September; later withdrawal and Guards designations need their own dates.
